ai-regulation.status: The United States continues a light‑touch regulatory approach, with no major AI legislation expected. India is preparing to publish a consultation paper on AI legislation in the coming weeks, while also planning a major hardware launch by late 2028.

agent-safety.status: Meta has paused the Muse conversation‑sharing feature after a security firm found thousands of publicly accessible links exposing data. Chinese‑aligned hackers used AI agents and the ARTEX framework to breach ConnectWise, compromising credentials for about 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants, and ConnectWise is working to restore its cloud backup service. Recent safety work includes mixed RLVR results, the new EpiSEM‑Bench benchmark, OpenAI’s partnership with Poland’s NASK, US banks blocking third‑party AI agents, OpenAI’s added offline environments and high‑compute red‑team testing, Anthropic’s Claude generating formal security proofs, and OpenAI now training frontier models offline.
agent-safety.changed: The newest story reports that OpenAI has resumed training its frontier models in an offline environment with added monitoring, keeping them offline until safeguards are improved.

ai-infrastructure.status: NVIDIA’s AI infrastructure now includes Confidential Bare Metal deployment, GA of Vera Rubin A5X instances, and expanded open‑weight model use across European government, finance, retail, and weather sectors.
